title: SPRI: Aligning Large Language Models with Context-Situated Principles
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models to human values and ethical principles through a context-situated framework. It evaluates alignment on tasks such as cognitive reappraisal and benchmarks like BiGGen Bench and TruthfulQA. Crucially, its core 'Seed Principles' used to guide the model include complex moral and ethical dilemmas such as reproductive rights (abortion laws), gender roles, and systemic barriers for people with disabilities.
